sections.title: Tree and range
sections.text: Pradosia kuhlmannii is a tree endemic to Brazil’s Atlantic coastal region, in humid lowland forest. The taxonomic revision describes it to about 15 m; a Brazilian conservation record reports trees up to 35 m, so height varies among sources.

sections.title: Leaves, flowers and fruit
sections.text: Its alternate leaves are about 4–11 × 1.4–4 cm. Small greenish flowers grow along the branches; the smooth green ellipsoid drupes are about 2.5–3.5 cm long.

sections.title: Taxonomy and food
sections.text: Chrysophyllum kuhlmannii is a synonym. The sources consulted do not confirm that the fruit is eaten.
